name: DEF-2308-801_def_2308_801_fujifilm_x_h2s_techinsights_proxy_stack
description: FDTD runnable proxy stack derived from TechInsights local metadata. Use as a starting geometry, not as a calibrated product deck.

calibration_status.note: Only public/report metadata fields were extracted; layer split and n,k remain proxy values.

shield.notes: Generated database keeps optical masks off unless a measured PDAF/aperture mask is modeled separately.

silicon.source: M. A. Green, Solar Energy Materials and Solar Cells 92, 1305-1310 (2008), via refractiveindex.info database.

cfa_red.source: n anchored to published image-sensor-chip patent example: red filter n=1.59 at 620 nm; k remains a proxy absorption curve.

cfa_green.source: n anchored to published image-sensor-chip patent example: green filter n=1.60 at 550 nm; k remains a proxy absorption curve.

cfa_blue.source: n anchored to published image-sensor-chip patent example: blue filter n=1.61 at 450 nm; k remains a proxy absorption curve.

passivation.source: SiO2-like effective dielectric using fused-silica visible dispersion; BSI Al2O3 passivation patents report 1-150 nm passivation, but this single-layer model cannot represent the full AR/passivation stack.

lens.source: n anchored to published image-sensor-chip patent example: microlens height 0.657 um and n=1.61; dispersion remains proxy.

metal.source: Stable PEC approximation for optional PDAF/edge-aperture masks. Use calibrated/dispersive metal only after stability and convergence checks.
metal.usage: optional PDAF/aperture mask only; not present when shield.mode is off

accuracy_notes: geometry_um.cfa_thickness is synchronized from image_sensor_db optical_qe_db CFA model; this is still proxy/research data unless measured CFA n,k and measured spectral QE are imported.
Generated from report metadata/tables, not from a process deck.
CFA/OCL/passivation split is a lumped proxy when only optical stack height is known.
Material n,k values are inherited from proxy reference files.
Run optical/TCAD convergence gates before using this quantitatively.
This config is not a product-calibrated sensor stack.
CFA and OCL refractive-index anchors are public patent example values, not target-product measured values.
CFA extinction coefficients are proxy values; public sources found did not provide full RGB n,k dispersion for a target sensor.
The single passivation layer approximates a more complex BSI passivation/AR stack.
Quantitative CRA/color response requires measured geometry and n,k data for the target sensor.
Use convergence sweeps with field-decay termination before using the LUT quantitatively.

reflected_values: upper planarization 0.3 um, n=1.56, not explicitly modeled
R/G/B filter n anchors: 1.59 at 620 nm, 1.60 at 550 nm, 1.61 at 450 nm
Al2O3 backside passivation range 1-150 nm; proxy config uses 80 nm effective dielectric
recent small-pixel DTI depth examples span roughly 1.7-3.8 um; proxy config uses 2.8 um Si optical thickness

public_references.topic: BSI optical-stack trend and lightpipe indices
reflected_values: BSI is mainstream for sub-1.5 um pixels
example lightpipe materials: SiN n=2.05 and organic fill n=1.6

techinsights_source.title: Sony IMX695AFR, Advanced Photo System Type-C (APS-C) Format, 26.1MP Resolution, 3.77μm Pixel Pitch, Stacked Back-Illuminated CMOS Image Sensor Device Essentials Folder
